item.title: Gurpreet Luthra
item.description:
Product Development | Product Strategy | High Performance Engineering Teams| Open Source Evangelist | Social Impact | Responsible Tech | Ex-Thoughtworks | 23+ years of Software Experience

As a Consultant, I focus on helping organizations build impactful products and create a culture of excellence through modern Product Development & Engineering practices.

For over 5 years, I have been a Product & Community Leader for Open Source Bahmni hospital software which has been adopted in over 800+ facilities worldwide.
